# Procurement Redlining Workflow Kickoff

Date: 2025-01-07  
Attendees: Dorrit Ravnham, Amadeo Ibbdale, Torben Fennmere  
Subject: Initiated project to automate vendor contract revision processes and approval routing  

**Agenda:**  
- Overview of current procurement redlining challenges  
- Definition of project scope and goals  
- Initial task assignments and timelines  

**Discussion:**  
Dorrit outlined that the current manual redlining process for vendor contracts averages 5 days per review cycle, contributing to procurement delays of up to 20%. Amadeo presented a preliminary analysis showing that automating clause extraction and redline suggestions could reduce review time by at least 40%, targeting a 3-day cycle. Torben emphasized the importance of integrating the workflow with existing contract management tools used by the Legal Ops team, estimated at 15,000 active contracts yearly.  

The team agreed the initial focus should be on automating the redlining of standard procurement clauses—specifically termination, confidentiality, and payment terms—comprising roughly 60% of all contracts reviewed. A phased approach will enable iterative testing and feedback.  

**Decisions:**  
- Project codename: “ProcureLine”  
- Target go-live for Phase 1: 2025-06-30  
- Use existing clause taxonomy for extraction (approx. 120 standard clauses)  

**Action Items:**  
- Dorrit to draft detailed workflow specs by 2025-01-21  
- Amadeo to prototype clause extraction module by 2025-02-15  
- Torben to coordinate integration requirements with Legal Ops by 2025-01-28
